# Unit Sheffield

> Unit (Unit Food) is an independent American diner and burger restaurant in Sheffield, UK, founded in 2016. Two restaurants: Headford Street in Sheffield city centre (S3) and Valley Centertainment near Meadowhall (S9). Smashed beef burgers, chicken burgers, buffalo wings, loaded fries, baos, waffles and shakes, made fresh to order, with vegan options. Eat in, takeaway, order for collection or delivery on Uber Eats.

## Restaurants

- Unit Headford Street: 88 Headford Street, Sheffield S3 7WB. Sheffield city centre, a short walk from Division Street, West Street and Devonshire Green. Close to the University of Sheffield and Sheffield Hallam University, and within walking distance of Bramall Lane (Sheffield United). Open Monday to Sunday, 11am to 11pm. Phone 0114 438 1532. Pay and display parking outside, free after 8:30pm.
- Unit Valley Centertainment: Unit 4, Valley Centertainment, Sheffield S9 2EP. Next to Cineworld and Hollywood Bowl, on Broughton Lane, the same road as Utilita Arena Sheffield (home of the Sheffield Steelers). A few minutes from Meadowhall and IKEA Sheffield, near iceSheffield and Sheffield Olympic Legacy Park. Valley Centertainment tram stop outside. Open Sunday to Thursday 10am to 10pm, Friday and Saturday 10am to 11pm. Phone 0114 399 2513. Free on-site parking.
- Last orders are 15 minutes before closing at both restaurants. Walk-ins welcome; booking recommended for groups and weekend evenings.

## Food

- Beef burgers with signature fries, smashed to order using meat from a local butcher
- Chicken burgers, buffalo and flavoured wings, tenders
- Loaded fries (including the Mac Ting), baos, salads
- Desserts and shakes: Miss Drippy shakes, churros, waffles, cookie dough
- Vegan: cauliflower wings, Moving Mountains vegan burger, falafel burger. Vegetarian: halloumi burger and halloumi fries
- The whole menu is halal. Gluten-free buns are available on any burger, or burgers can be served without a bun; the kitchen handles gluten, so not recommended for coeliacs due to cross-contamination risk
- Kids menu available
